sense.text:
A lot of our people ask where God was when we were enslaved, lynched and our women raped, and why he sat back and watched. The answer is here: “your iniquities have separated between you and your God.” The white man would have had no power against us if we had stayed in God’s commandments. Because we broke them and did all manner of wickedness, we went into captivity. That is what captivity is: God’s chosen people breaking his laws, and God putting them into captivity for it. Plain and simple.

The Most High is not the God of everybody. He is the God of the nation of Israel, the twelve tribes, and the Christians need to get that out of the way first.

“And your sins have hid his face from you.” That is why he sat back. He told us, we would not listen, and now he sits back to see what we will do. Our people have to know how a pale, filthy man came to be over us, and the answer is our sin.

“Your iniquities have turned away these things, and your sins have withholden good things from you.” God is telling us what is going on with us and what we need, so that he can flip the table upside down.

Now that we know we are the children of Israel, we take hold of his commandments and let God do the job for us: he will fight against these nations. That is what the wars, the famine and the fires are about. God is telling us to get ready, because he is about to destroy this place.

The sister who asked where God was during slavery said he watched it and allowed it, and up to a point she is right. Most of our people think the way she does. They were raised in Christianity on a god who is all love, joy and peace, so when they look at what happened to our people they cannot understand it. Christianity throws away the laws and the Old Testament, so they read half a book and get half a god. The God of the Bible is a God of anger and wrath, who set laws and commandments before his people with consequences they knew about when they agreed to them.

“I said, I would scatter them into corners”: the prophecy that the Israelites would be scattered into the four corners of the earth as slaves, and it came to pass on the so-called blacks and Hispanics.

“I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men”: the remembrance that we are the children of Israel has ceased. Ask any man today who the Israelites are and he will point to the fake Jews in the land of Israel, not to the children of the slave trade. The furthest we can take ourselves back is Africa, and we cannot even say which place in Africa. It was a system designed to destroy the children of Israel.

This is why we do not know who we are. God entered into a covenant with the so-called Negroes of the slave trade, the blacks in America, the Caribbean islands, the North American Indians, the Puerto Ricans, scattered to the four corners of the earth. We agreed to keep all his laws and be his people, but there was a stipulation: “if thou wilt not hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command thee this day; that all these curses shall come upon thee, and overtake thee”.

Break the covenant and bad things come, and those bad things are called curses. Are the so-called Negroes in America cursed? Yes. We are under the curses.

“Thy sons and thy daughters shall be given unto another people”: that happened in slavery, when children were taken from their parents in Africa and brought to the Americas, to Dominica and to this side of the world. God said these things would happen to us if we did not keep his commandments, and that he would not help us, because we turned against him and broke his covenant.

“And thine eyes shall look, and fail with longing for them all the day long”. “And there shall be no might in thine hand”: our forefathers had no military might to go and get their children back from the shores of America, Britain, Jamaica and Haiti. The other people they were given to are the Caucasian race, and the Arabs as well, because there was also the Sahara slave trade.

These are the answers to why we were enslaved and why we go through what we go through: we are the children of God, his people, and we broke his covenant, and that covenant came with judgments and curses.

“Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”: that is what we have done for hundreds of years in America and the Caribbean islands, in the sugar cane fields and the cotton fields, and even the jobs we have today are serving our enemies. God calls the people who enslaved us our enemies. They are not our friends and not our neighbours.

“Which the Lord shall send against thee”: the Lord sent them. He let the conquistadors come and conquer the Mexicans, he let them colonize Africa, enslave us there and bring us here, because we turned against him and broke his laws. The Lord sent the so-called white man against us to destroy us. Our God is a horrible God: he sent them against us for our sins. That is the answer for the sister, and for everyone wondering why we are at the bottom of society.

“In hunger, and in thirst, and in nakedness, and in want of all things”: anything we want, an education, a bank loan, food, clothing, we have to go to our enemy for it.

“And he shall put a yoke of iron upon thy neck, until he have destroyed thee.” We had yokes of iron on our necks in slavery. When Abraham Lincoln claimed to free the slaves we were already destroyed as a people; we no longer knew we were the children of Israel, and that is why they took the physical chains off. The Lord was there and saw it all, but it was punishment from God. We are not like any other race: we went into a covenant with the Creator and did not keep it, so he punished us as his children, the way a father disciplines a disobedient child for his good.

Egypt here is the house of bondage, oppression and captivity. Israel never went back into ancient Egypt in ships, so this is a new Egypt: America and the lands where we were made slaves.

“There ye shall be sold unto your enemies for bondmen and bondwomen”: written thousands of years ago, and it happened in the 1600s. When we came off the slave ships in Virginia, in America and in the Caribbean islands, we were sold to the so-called white man, and we have served our enemies for hundreds of years. Nobody can say everybody was enslaved at some point. Nations warred and took captives, but this is chattel slavery of a whole nation: scattered over the world in ships, enslaved for over 400 years, their identity lost, still in the diaspora today. Name another nation that went through that. There is none. It is not talking about the Chinese, the Arabs or white people; it is talking about the children of Israel.

“And no man shall buy you”: no man is going to redeem us out of that condition. The only one who will redeem us from that slavery and oppression is our King, Christ.

“Come forth, and flee from the land of the north”: the land of the north is North America. “For I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven”: Israel was scattered, spread abroad to the four corners of the earth in slavery.

“Deliver thyself, O Zion, that dwellest with the daughter of Babylon.” Zion is first and foremost Judah, the city of David, the royal lineage of David. The daughter of Babylon is Edom, the Caucasian race, and here it is America. So Zion is dwelling in America, the kingdom of Judah living here as slaves.

The white man is now saying what we have taught for years: that on the old maps of Africa there was a Negroland and a kingdom of Judah along the Niger, and that European, Ashkenazi slave merchants out of Portugal and Britain employed Muslim trappers to go into the kingdom of Judah and take the royal house of Judah captive in slave ships, as it is recorded in Deuteronomy, and bring them to America, where they became known as African Americans. Other migrations came later, from the islands, Haiti and Puerto Rico, but those brought here as slaves in the 1600s are the royal lineage of Judah. They are Zion.

“The nations which spoiled you” are the nations that enslaved us, and the Lord of hosts is coming to them to judge them.

Many peoples have been enslaved on this earth, but there is a difference with God’s people. Those who went over to Africa, took us and brought us here as slaves took part in destroying the people of God, and “he that toucheth you toucheth the apple of his eye”: his special people, the ones he loves. That is why there will be punishment for touching the children of Israel.

precepts.why:
“Take a good heart, O Jerusalem: for he that gave thee that name will comfort thee.” The scripture says he that toucheth thee toucheth the apple of his eye, and here it says “Miserable are they that afflicted thee, and rejoiced at thy fall.” Every nation that afflicted us, enslaved us and lynched us, and rejoiced at our fall when we were enslaved, is going to be miserable.

“Miserable are the cities which thy children served”: all the places we were made slaves, America, Virginia, Britain. They will be miserable when our King returns, because he brings destruction on them. “Miserable is she that received thy sons”: the she that received Israel’s sons is the daughter of Babylon.

“For as she rejoiced at thy ruin, and was glad of thy fall: so shall she be grieved for her own desolation.” The daughter of Babylon, America, is going to be destroyed. “I will take away the rejoicing of her great multitude, and her pride shall be turned into mourning.” “For fire shall come upon her from the Everlasting”: that is nuclear destruction.

So miserable are those our children have served, and the judgment on those we have been serving is fire. That is the judgment for touching us.

Who is the she, the daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.” They said destroy Jerusalem, even to the foundation.

“O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed”. The daughter of Babylon is Edom, the Caucasian race. That is the she that received thy sons in Baruch. So when Zechariah says flee from the land of the north and deliver thyself, O Zion, from the daughter of Babylon, it is talking about here in America.

This explains who Zion is. Solomon assembled the elders and heads of the tribes “that they might bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.”

Zion is the city of David. So when it says deliver thyself, O Zion, it is speaking first and foremost of Judah, who is in the city of David: David’s family lineage, the kingdom of Judah.
“But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.” The tribe of Judah is mount Zion. Zion first and foremost is Judah.

sense.text: “They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search”. They have archaeologists and scholars whose job is to search out information about the lost tribes. They find it, and they cannot hold it in. That is the Lord putting it on their spirit to reveal these things to us, like the young Jewish rabbi amazed that the people of the slave trade descend from the Jews of West Africa.

“So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves”. They did not get the memo and have no handlers to control them. They worry about what black celebrities say, while their own people spill the beans. A black celebrity is ignored, but when a white scholar puts it out, people pay attention. The books they cite to confirm it, we have had for years.

Judah, the royal lineage of David, was brought to the Americas. That is Zion dwelling with the daughter of Babylon, and here is what was done to him.

“And he shall speak great words against the most High”: that is the so-called white man. His great words are calling himself a Jew, setting himself up as God, as Christ, as the people of God.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: he wore us out in slavery. Wear out a shirt and it is unrecognizable; wear a Nike shoe long enough and the sign falls off and it does not look like a Nike any more. They wore us out until we no longer know who we are, and then took our identity and nationality and called themselves Jews. “And think to change times and laws”: he changed times and changed God’s laws.

“And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” A time is 100 years, times is 200, and the dividing of time is 50: 350 years we would be given into their hands, destroyed and not knowing who we are. It is talking about Zion, the royal tribe of Judah.

precepts.why:
“How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?” The wonders are us being scattered in slavery and destroyed.

The man clothed in linen swore “that it shall be for a time, times, and an half”. A time is 100 years, times 200 more, and the half 50: we would be enslaved and worn out by this man for 350 years. The same count as the time and times and the dividing of time in Daniel 7:25.

“And to the woman were given two wings of a great eagle”. The woman is Zion, Israel. She is “nourished for a time, and times, and half a time”: 100, 200 and 50, the same 350 years in which the children of Israel would be enslaved and destroyed as a people, not knowing the truth of who they are.

“From the face of the serpent”: the serpent is the great red dragon of Revelation 12, the so-called white man, the daughter of Babylon that Zion dwells with in Zechariah. We were nourished from his face because we had to serve him for the want of all things, as Deuteronomy 28 said, for 350 years.

sense.text:
“And their dead bodies”: the Israelites, because we are in a dead state of mind here in America, spiritually dead. “Shall lie in the street of the great city”: the great city is America, the greatest city on the planet, the daughter of Babylon.

“Which spiritually is called Sodom”, because homosexuality is promoted and legalized here, “and Egypt”, because the children of Israel are oppressed and enslaved here. Egypt means oppression, to be kept in. This place is spiritual Egypt, the house of bondage.

“And after three days and an half” is the 350 years read in Revelation 12:14, Daniel 12:6-7 and Daniel 7:25. “The Spirit of life from God entered into them”: the Holy Spirit enters into Zion, into Judah here in America, the royal lineage of David, because the prophets and the apostles are coming through the house of David, and they will wake up the prophets of the other tribes, from the islands, Haiti and Puerto Rico. After 350 years Israel starts waking up.

Count it: in 1619 the first of the royal kingdom of Judah touched the shores of America. 1619 plus 350 is 1969, the year Abba Bivens set up the school, the original One West Camp, and the truth began to really be taught on the earth. We all descend from him, and his sons are the ones teaching on the streets today and waking our people up to the truth that they are the Israelites. Those who keep the commandments, overcome their sins and deal right with their brothers without hatred are the men God will use as revolutionaries in these last days; those full of hatred and sin the Lord will push to the side.

Esau counts slavery from 1441, when the Portuguese first took our people, but the pivotal year was 1619, when they brought Zion here. That marked the time of the end, and it is no coincidence that the 1960s were the turbulent sixties: COINTELPRO and the covert operations set up to stop the rise of a black Messiah, while the one they feared was already teaching.

precepts.why:
The dead bodies in the street of the great city are the slain here. “Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.” The slain are the dead Israelites in America.

“And the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet”: the same as after three days and an half the Spirit of life from God entered into them. “An exceeding great army”: that is what will take place. It already began with IUIC, and an exceeding great army, a spiritual army, is going to rise up here in America.

“These bones are the whole house of Israel”, not the Chinese, not the Arabs, not the Caucasians, not the Moabites: the twelve tribes scattered in slavery who forgot who they are. That is who the Most High is resurrecting.

“Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.” That is what our people think, like the sister in the video asking where God was. When our people were being lynched and oppressed they had no hope; they felt cut off from their God, that God was not listening and not dealing with them.

“And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin”. When something is covered with skin, it shows identity: it shows this is a black man. So when we are covered with skin, we start to seek identity, and that is why in the sixties our people were seeking identity, trying to figure out who they are and calling themselves all manner of names. That is the three days and an half coming to pass.

“And put breath in you”: the breath of life coming in is a process. It started in the sixties with our forefathers and kept growing. The spirit of God was on all the brothers who rose up in the sixties, on different levels. Whatever form of fight they took against oppression, they did it because they saw their people hurting, and some are still in jail today as prisoners of war. So we will never criticize the leaders of the past. We are where we are today because of these men. This is Judah.

sense.text: Zion is here in America, and Zion is Judah, so these are prophecies concerning us. “Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you that which shall befall you in the last days.” Jacob was a prophet, and the Lord showed him what would happen to each of his sons’ descendants in the last days. Here is what happens to the house of Judah, the house of David, Zion.

“Judah, thou art he whom thy brethren shall praise”. Even in a carnal sense everybody looks up to black Americans and follows them; black Americans set the trends all over the world. It will be the same in righteousness: Judah, starting with Christ and the twelve, will be the ones waking the brothers and sisters up in these last days.

“Thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies”: for your hand to be in the neck of your enemy, you have to be living among him. That is Zion dwelling with the daughter of Babylon. Judah lives with the enemy who enslaved him. In the islands they left us by ourselves in the sixties and went back to Britain, but here in America Judah was living with his enemy, and his hand in the neck of his enemies is Judah fighting the people who enslaved him.

That is Martin Luther King rising up against the oppression of our people, Malcolm X, Marcus Garvey, Fred Hampton and the Black Panther Party, who walked into the Capitol with guns until Esau changed the law. That is Judah. These men may be called militant and nationalists, but the cops were killing our people, and the spirit of God was on them to a level: they had love for their brothers and their people and said they would not sit back and let it happen any more. And the Bible prophesied it.

“Judah is a lion’s whelp”: a young, strong lion. That was Malcolm X, Martin Luther King, all the revolutionary brothers who rose up young and strong and did not care whether they lived or died. “From the prey, my son, thou art gone up”: they were mobilizing to take the system down. “He stooped down, he couched as a lion”: imagine how scared white society was, after decades of lynching black people, when a cop killed a black man and the Black Panthers showed up at his house.

“And as an old lion”: then he turned into an old lion, and that is COINTELPRO. FBI documents say its purpose was to expose, disrupt, misdirect, discredit or otherwise neutralize the black nationalists. Hoover said the most dangerous thing is black unity. Neutralize means murder: Malcolm X, Martin Luther King and Fred Hampton were all murdered by white society and the US government.

They also neutralized us with traps: crack, heroin, alcohol and drugs brought into the black community, so that revolutionaries and doctors became crackheads and brothers sold drugs to their own people. And they raised the smart ones up into white society with jobs and political positions, so that a smart one would not become a leader against them in the ghetto. He becomes comfortable, loses his identity and his racial anger, becomes alien to his brothers and one of them. Racial anger is understanding who your enemy is and hating your enemy; when the Bible says love your enemy it is talking about your own brothers, as David loved Saul, not the ones who enslaved and lynched you. Civil rights, welfare, public assistance, the white woman and interracial marriage legalized in the sixties: all of it turned Judah into an old lion.

“Who shall rouse him up?” The spirit of Christ is going to rouse Judah back up into the young lion he was in the sixties.

In Jeremiah’s day there were prophets prophesying against him, saying the captivity would not happen, coming up with lies out of their own minds. This scripture also suits Martin Luther King today. God speaks to the prophets in a vision or in a dream, so these prophets say “I have dreamed, I have dreamed.” I have a dream.
“They are prophets of the deceit of their own heart”: that dream is the deceit of their own mind.
“Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour”. That is what they are ultimately trying to do: cause the people to forget God’s name.

“The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully.” Martin Luther King gave the speech where he had a dream of little black boys and little white girls walking and holding hands together. That dream was not the plan of God, but it is written in prophecy. Martin Luther King had good intentions: he was trying to liberate his people from oppression and get them rights. But history shows the speech was not written by him, and his movement was hijacked and turned into something that fulfilled prophecy.

Here is God’s vision, and whether he supports that dream. “When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam”: he separated all nations from us. The nations are not supposed to be integrated together; God is against that. “He set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.” God is about separation.

precepts.why:
“The sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.” The sons of God are the sons of Adam, Adam’s descendants, the holy lineage created in God’s image and likeness. They were not supposed to mix with the daughters of men, but they married them.

That is why God was angry: “My spirit shall not always strive with man”, and “yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.” God judged us by making our days shorter when we intermarried with the heathen. Interracial marriage is wrong.

“When the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.” The sons of God were different from the children of men: the spirit of God was in them and they had supernatural powers in the beginning, so when they mixed, demigods were born through them.

“For thou art an holy people unto the Lord thy God: the Lord thy God hath chosen thee to be a special people unto himself”. Martin Luther King’s dream, or the speech they helped him write, is against God’s program, though it is in prophecy. God separated Israel as a special people.

When God brought Israel into the land and cast out the seven nations, “thou shalt make no covenant with them, nor shew mercy unto them”. “Neither shalt thou make marriages with them; thy daughter thou shalt not give unto his son, nor his daughter shalt thou take unto thy son.”

“For they will turn away thy son from following me”. God is about separation. He is against the sons of God, the Israelites, marrying into other nations. Do not marry outside your nation; it is against God’s laws.

The civil rights that Judah fought for, that Martin Luther King fought for, were hijacked and used to establish Babylon the great, fulfilling prophecy.

sense.text: The rights the slaves fought for here, not to be lynched, to use the same bathroom, to ride the bus, not to be killed or oppressed, were hijacked. Everybody who comes here has civil rights because of black people, paid for with the blood of Judah, and then they call black Americans lazy. That hijacked movement was used to establish Mystery Babylon the great, and it begins here: “the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.”

“Let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.” Babel means confusion. This is the beginning of Babylon, the first Babylon.

“Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language”. God came down and confounded their language because they said let us all be one people. They were not one people, but because they spoke one language they gathered together and said wherever we go, everybody will know we are from here.

It is the same spirit America has: wherever you are from, you come here and you are an American, one people, the great melting pot. Nimrod and ancient Babylon did it, and America is doing the same thing. God is against that.

precepts.why:
“The great whore that sitteth upon many waters”, “with whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication”. The woman sits upon a beast “having seven heads and ten horns”: the seven heads are the seven major white nations that rose up, and the ten horns are the European Union.

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT”. She is called Mystery Babylon the great because she has the same spirit as Nimrod and ancient Babylon, heaping all people to herself and saying let us be one. Ancient Babylon gathered all people together as one, and so does America: you can go to live in France, Germany, Turkey or Japan and never become a Frenchman, a German, a Turk or Japanese, but anyone from any corner of the earth can come to live in America and become an American. That is prophecy.

How was America able to fulfil it? It was not allowed before the sixties. When the civil rights of Martin Luther King were hijacked, America fully became Mystery Babylon the great, and all people came from every corner of the earth to live here and call themselves Americans. The rights were given to everybody, the American dream came alive, and before that they were murdering and lynching black people like crazy.

“And I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus”.

“And the fourth kingdom shall be strong as iron”: that is Rome. These kingdoms are the times of the Gentiles, ruling the earth before Christ returns and destroys them. “The feet and toes” are the end of the kingdom, the era we live in now, Europe and America. The iron is the white man who ruled Rome.

“The kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”: military strength like Rome, but divided. “So the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” The whole system is broken, and Trump trying to fix it by deporting everybody will not work.

“And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men”. When did they start mingling with the other nations? In the sixties. That is the civil rights movement being hijacked: it became fine for a black man to marry a white woman, for an East Indian to marry a white man, and they started putting black people in government positions to neutralize the smart ones, take away the racial anger and the revolutionary spirit, and make us feel included.

“But they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.” Even with integration, all nations will never be united in America. There will always be division and civil uprising: rednecks rising up, Arabs cursing out the government, Chinatown here and the ghetto there. Do not be fooled by the idea of equality and integration.

“Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.” “For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie”.

“Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”: that is the Caucasian; his soul is not right in him. “But the just shall live by his faith”: that is us following Christ, reading the same Bible they claim to believe.

“He is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: America is never at home; it is in every people’s country, with over 700 military bases around the globe. He “enlargeth his desire as hell, and is as death, and cannot be satisfied, but gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people”. Babel and Nimrod did that in the beginning, and America does it in the last days. That is why it is Mystery Babylon the great, and all nations came to live here through the civil rights our forefathers fought for, which were hijacked, and then Martin Luther King was murdered.

“Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him”: the very people he heaped to himself and made citizens will rise up against him when they realize the reason they are here is that he is robbing and killing in their countries.

“They shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it”: America causes confusion, wars and chaos, then takes what it wants. It is built on war, stealing and murder.

“Then shall his mind change”: that is what happened in the sixties. America made itself the light-bearer to the world, a Christian nation about love, peace and equal rights for everyone, after having said I am not equal to you, do not pray with me, do not use my bathroom. They hijacked the civil rights from Martin Luther King, murdered him, and acted as though they were always righteous.

“Imputing this his power unto his god”: he set up Christianity and did everything in the name of Jesus, the image of the beast. In God we trust. But his mind did not really change: he still bombs and murders people today, only slickly and deceitfully.

sense.text:
“Never trust thine enemy”. During the civil rights movement many white people, especially Jewish white people, came into the movement acting like they were helping Martin Luther King, but they were working for the FBI, undermining him and feeding him things, because the plan was to make America the nation it is today. Stanley Levison, who helped write the I Have a Dream speech, was one of them, and the so-called Jews brought the money into the movement.

“For like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.”

“Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him”. He comes saying he wants to help with the black struggle, but he has an ulterior motive. “Thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass”: you will see him for what he is. “Thou shalt know that his rust hath not been altogether wiped away”: his rust is his evil, and it is still there. Never trust your enemies.

Martin Luther King understood it, but too late. He told a friend five days before he was murdered that he was afraid he was integrating his people into a burning house; he saw that America had lost its moral vision and that black people were struggling to get into a system that is a Sodom and Gomorrah. When he said he had been to the mountaintop and seen the promised land, he was not talking about America; he was speaking of the land promised to us, the kingdom. He knew they were about to kill him. Do not sleep on Martin Luther King: he loved his people, and everything he did was for their betterment, but his movement was hijacked by liberals and by Jewish people.

Martin Luther King said he was integrating his people into a burning house; the burnt mountain of Jeremiah is the same thing. Here is the house: “That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof; that opened not the house of his prisoners”. America is that house, and we are the prisoners, the slaves in it. The rights they gave us never let us go out of slavery. We are still slaves in this land.

Here are the nonviolent movement of Martin and the any-means-necessary movement of Malcolm in a few verses. Those pursued are our people, the Israelites who refused to follow the commandment of the Greeks, and they “made war against them on the sabbath day.” “But they said, We will not come forth, neither will we do the king’s commandment, to profane the sabbath day.” The Greeks were forcing us to go against our laws on the sabbath.

“Howbeit they answered them not, neither cast they a stone at them”: our brothers and sisters did not respond to the attack. No resistance. “Let us die all in our innocency: heaven and earth shall testify for us, that ye put us to death wrongfully.” If you kill us, the world will know you killed innocent men, women and children who did not fight back. That is nonviolence, and they slew a thousand of our people who chose to leave this world non-violently.

Now Malcolm. Mattathias and his friends “mourned for them right sore.” The Greeks had learned our law, that we would not fight on the sabbath, so all they had to do was wait for the sabbath and attack. “If we all do as our brethren have done, and fight not for our lives and laws against the heathen, they will now quickly root us out of the earth.”

So they decreed: “Whosoever shall come to make battle with us on the sabbath day, we will fight against him”. By any means necessary. “Neither will we die all, as our brethren that were murdered in the secret places”: that is churches bombed, people killed in the streets and dogs set on them. No turning the other cheek. This is not advocating violence; it shows the contrast, and that our forefathers in that time had to defend themselves because the Greeks were trying to destroy us.

This is the spirit that was on the Black Panther Party. “When Moses was grown, that he went out unto his brethren, and looked on their burdens”: he saw the affliction and oppression of our people. “And he spied an Egyptian smiting an Hebrew, one of his brethren.”

“He looked this way and that way, and when he saw that there was no man, he slew the Egyptian”. That is the kind of love Moses had for his brothers. Moses was one of the meekest men on the earth, and he killed that Egyptian because of the love he had for his people when he saw him oppressing his brother.

Now we understand why the Black Panthers thought the way they did, why they broke Assata Shakur out of prison, and why one of them is still locked up for it. Many of those brothers did not understand the scriptures; they only knew they could not sit down and allow it, so they picked up guns and defended their people.

But it has to be balanced: we do not do that today. We do not pick up weapons against any government. We tear this government down with the Bible, the word of God.

They call revolutionaries terrorists: the Black Panthers, Martin, Malcolm, the Mau Mau fighting for their land, and they will call us extremists and terrorists too. That is biblical. Zion is Judah, and “the land of Judah shall be a terror unto Egypt”. America is spiritual Egypt, and we will be a terror to it.

“Every one that maketh mention thereof shall be afraid in himself, because of the counsel of the Lord of hosts”: not because of guns, bombs, grenades or some militia, but the counsel of the Lord, the words of the prophets taught in the streets. That is what will strike fear in the hearts of our oppressor, because everything we prophesy will manifest in this place, and our enemy will see it.

“Thy hand shall be in the neck of thine enemies”: the revolutionary brothers who rose up in the past fighting against the enemy, Malcolm X, Martin Luther King, the Black Panther Party.

A revolution has been started, but the revolution has evolved. Our forefathers inspire us, and the spirit of God has entered.

“From the prey, my son, thou art gone up”: a young strong lion going up against oppression. “He stooped down, he couched as a lion”: at one point it seemed black Americans might get land in America. “And as an old lion”: then the civil rights, the crumbs they gave us and the white woman turned us into an old lion.

“Who shall rouse him up?” This is the end part, where we are now: the evolution of the revolution. The spirit of Christ has roused Judah, and you see Judah waking up all over the South and all over the world. Bishop made a war cry for brothers to hit the four corners of the earth, and Judah is rising, with Levites, Ephraim and Benjamin helping him, travelling the world and teaching the gospel.

“When the kingdom of God should come”: the kingdom of God is a revolution. It is land, us having our own government. “The kingdom of God cometh not with observation”: it does not come by sitting down scratching.

“Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there!” That is not how it comes. “For, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.” It is in us to go out, teach and wake up our people, to put in the work and start the revolution. It starts with us, and the revolution has already begun.

precepts.why:
“And in the days of these kings shall the God of heaven set up a kingdom”. The days of these kings are Europe and America, and in their days God sets up a literal kingdom: he starts a revolution.

Christ said the kingdom is within you, so in the days of these kings the kingdom starts to be established by us teaching the gospel of Christ and sparking the revolution in the hearts of our people.

Some think the kingdom of heaven means living up in the sky. David says the Lord “hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.” The kingdom of God, the kingdom of heaven, was Solomon ruling over Israel. It is about rulership of this earth, about land, and our being put back in our land.

“Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel?” The Romans were ruling Israel then, with Herod set up under them, so the apostles were asking Christ: are you going to start the revolution now, kill the Romans and give us back our land? A revolution is always about land. There cannot be a revolution without land.

sense.text:
“Ye which have followed me, in the regeneration”: the apostles are reborn on this earth in another generation; they are here in the last days. “When the Son of man shall sit in the throne of his glory”: the throne of his glory is rulership of this earth. “Ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones”: thrones are governments, kingdoms, rulership. That is a revolution.

Marcus Garvey, Martin Luther King, Malcolm X and many great leaders rose up from the early 1900s through the sixties, and they were assassinated. One was a Muslim, one was a Christian, they all had their chance, and our people are still in the condition they were in during the civil rights movement.

precepts.why:
“For I think that God hath set forth us the apostles last”. After all those leaders rose up and had their chance, God sends the apostles last.

“As it were appointed to death”: it is appointed for these men to die, because all revolutionaries die. A revolutionary makes up his mind to be a martyr and die for his people.

“Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.” Her is America, Mystery Babylon the great. The holy apostles are the twelve, and they are here teaching the word of God, and there are prophets here in America.

God has to avenge them on America because in the future they will kill the apostles. The apostles were appointed unto death because they are revolutionaries, and they have started a spiritual revolution here that will destroy this place.

This is the state of mind of the revolutionaries in America, the apostles and the prophets. “And they overcame him by the blood of the Lamb”: we overcome the white man through the blood of Christ, “and by the word of their testimony”, our prophesying. We are not picking up guns to overcome Esau and his military.

“And they loved not their lives unto the death.” You can threaten these men with death; they live for the people, love the people and will die for the people. America will kill them and they will become martyrs. They do not love their lives unto death because they know that when they leave this body they go to their King, who said whoever believes in him will never die, and that there is a resurrection. It is you brothers who are waking up. The revolution has evolved.

sense.text:
This revolution they will not be able to destroy. “Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people”. The black Americans, the slaves brought here, are the house of Judah. Israel has been scattered to the four corners of the earth, and Judah here in America is going to find them and start a revolution in every country around the world. It is not just in America; it is worldwide.

“Let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.” In the sixties Judah was fighting his enemies, but now that the Spirit of life from God has entered Judah, the Lord helps him. The Lord is the one helping us in this war, this battle, this revolution, and we always give God the thanks and praise.

“And though the Lord give you the bread of adversity, and the water of affliction”: we go through adversity and affliction. “Yet shall not thy teachers be removed into a corner any more”: God scattered us into corners, but the teachers, the prophets, will not be in the corners any more. “But thine eyes shall see thy teachers”: this revolution will be televised. Esau tries to hide the truth and shadow ban us, but he will not be able to, because the people’s eyes will see their teachers.

precepts.why: “He delivereth the poor in his affliction, and openeth their ears in oppression.” When you are being oppressed, that is when your ears open to the truth. That is how our people work: they do not listen to God unless they are being oppressed.

“I will go and return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.” When we are afflicted, that is when we seek him.

Today was Trump’s inauguration, and his policies will turn up affliction on our people. Malcolm X spoke of the seed in the soil that waits for the season to change: political, economic and social conditions made black people more receptive in his day. The season is about to change again, the Klan no longer wears masks but sits in government, and in the next ten years Israel will grow into the hundreds of thousands or millions. Not everyone who comes through the doors will be right, but the revolution has started and it does not stop; the Most High can raise up anybody to carry it.

sense.text: If you are not a nationalist you cannot be a revolutionist: you cannot start a revolution if you do not love your nation or do not want a nation. When the Greeks tried to rule over us, Mattathias and his sons rose up and started a revolution. Judas determined “to go forth and try the matter in fight by the help of the Lord”: he was ready to shed blood, and in every revolution there is bloodshed.

He “exhorted his soldiers to fight manfully, even unto death, for the laws, the temple, the city, the country”. All revolutionaries understand they can die in what they do. Judas Maccabeus and his men were not only revolutionaries but nationalists: they loved their nation and their people. A revolutionary is a nationalist ready to die for his country and his people.
“I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.” We rebelled against our Lord.

“The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib: but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.” The crib is our land, our house; just the way he talks lets you know the God of the Bible talks like a black American. Israel does not know who our God is and does not know where our land is. That is saying we are not nationalists.

During the civil rights we fought a revolution to sit on the same toilet and be in the same park. That is not a revolution. In a revolution you want land, a country you can govern and rule for yourself; that is how you come out from under oppression. We do not consider who our God is or where our land is; we think it is somewhere in Africa.

precepts.why:
To be a revolutionary you must know your homeland, love it and be willing to die for it. “If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth”: if you do not remember Jerusalem, you are a dummy who cannot talk. That is the pastors teaching the Bible: if you do not know you are an Israelite and Jerusalem is your homeland, nothing you teach will make sense. The first step in understanding the Bible is knowing who the children of Israel are.

“If I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.” Jerusalem should be our chief joy, not Jamaica, America, Trinidad, Haiti or any of these lands they gave us independence from. If you are God’s revolutionary, a nationalist, Jerusalem is the land you look forward to, and you want your land back.

sense.text: “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land”. To be a revolutionary is about having your own land. But for Christ to put us back in our own land, blood has to be shed. There cannot be a revolution without bloodshed. “And the strangers shall be joined with them”.

“And the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids”: the nations will be our servants. “And they shall take them captives, whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.” That is God’s revolution: bloodshed, and us ruling over our oppressors. A revolution destroys anything in its way and does not compromise. If you are not talking about a nation, but some pie in the sky, you do not understand what the Bible is talking about.

precepts.why:
“These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them afar off”. Our forefathers died without receiving them. They “confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.” We are strangers and pilgrims here in America: these places are not our land; we are prisoners in this land.

“For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.” You have to say plainly that you want a country. A revolutionary wants land, his country, his own nation and government, not rights to sit on a toilet.

“But now they desire a better country, that is, an heavenly”: the heavenly country is the city created for us, the New Jerusalem that comes down on earth, a whole spiritual opening from the earth to the heavens, after we rule on this earth for a thousand years.

sense.text:
There will be no revolution without bloodshed, but we are not the ones picking up guns to fight. Nobody upstages the King: a king always goes to war first, on the front line, and he sheds the first blood.

“So of thy people was accepted both the salvation of the righteous, and destruction of the enemies.” For a revolution to take place your enemies have to be destroyed. You have to know who your enemy is and where your land is. There cannot be salvation without the enemy being destroyed.
“For wherewith thou didst punish our adversaries, by the same thou didst glorify us, whom thou hadst called.” This was a revolution.

precepts.why: “It is a righteous thing with God to recompense tribulation to them that trouble you”. Those who trouble us, our God will intervene against and recompense with tribulation. They are going to catch hell. He is going to destroy them.

sense.text: “The Lord shall go forth as a mighty man, he shall stir up jealousy like a man of war: he shall cry, yea, roar; he shall prevail against his enemies.” This is when Christ returns, and he is going to shed much blood on this earth.

“I have long time holden my peace; I have been still, and refrained myself”. While they lynched us in slavery, for all the evil the so-called white nations did against the children of Israel, the Lord held his peace and held himself back from intervening, and he holds it for what they will do to us in the coming years, when the government comes down hard on our people and kills many of the saints and apostles in America.

“Now will I cry like a travailing woman; I will destroy and devour at once.” There will be no revolution without bloodshed, and Christ is coming back to destroy and devour at once.
“I will make waste mountains and hills”: Europe, America and China will be wasted.

“And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood”: there will be no revolution without bloodshed. That is the blood of his enemies, the blood of the Europeans, the Jewish people and the Arabs. “And his name is called The Word of God.”
“And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses”: all the armies of heaven follow Christ when he comes to invade this earth.

“Out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations”. That is a revolution: to set up his kingdom he has to smite the nations, and he is not playing with them. “He shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.” He is going to do a lot of killing.

“KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.” He is King of kings because we will be a nation of kings and priests. It does not mean he is king over the nations as kings: when he returns they will be slaves and no longer kings. David will be one of the top kings under Christ.

“Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah?” He is coming from the Caucasian race, from Edom. “Travelling in the greatness of his strength”: with all the armies of heaven. “I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”

“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?” His garments look like someone who was stamping grapes. As Malcolm X said, there is no peaceful revolution. They will shed our blood, and our King will return and shed theirs.

“I have trodden the winepress alone; and of the people there was none with me”: he destroys the nations by himself. “For I will tread them in mine anger, and trample them in my fury”: Europe, America and all the nations, because he is angry for what they have done. “And their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments, and I will stain all my raiment.”

No turning the other cheek: Christ is coming for vengeance. We are not praying for their healing; we pray for Christ to return and stamp them like grapes. The Bible is a violent book. Some will call that hateful, but this is a nationalist and a revolutionist who loves his people. Stop always trying to save the heathen; get yourself together, stop the adultery, lying and stealing, and come back to the God of Israel.

“For the day of vengeance is in mine heart”: vengeance belongs to the Lord, and the day of vengeance is in Christ’s hand. “And the year of my redeemed is come”: the year he redeems us from the lands where we were made slaves.
“And I will tread down the people in mine anger”: the Europeans, the Arabs, the nations. “And I will bring down their strength to the earth”: their armies will be destroyed.

“The great goodness toward the house of Israel, which he hath bestowed on them according to his mercies”. “For he said, Surely they are my people, children that will not lie: so he was their Saviour.” His people are Israel. Christ is our Saviour; he will save us and tread the nations. He is the biggest revolutionary.

He died a revolutionary death: they hanged our King on a tree, lynched him the way our forefathers died in slavery, and cursed is every one that hangeth on a tree. He died a black death, and that tells you our King is a black man.

“In all their affliction he was afflicted”: everything the white man did and said to us, Christ felt, because we are one with our King and he dwells in us. That is why he is angry. “And the angel of his presence saved them”: that is Michael. “In his love and in his pity he redeemed them”.

Now the King has returned, and he is about to destroy all the nations. So do not be ashamed to be a revolutionary, and do not be afraid to be a nationalist.
